description: VOL-99 performance budgets. `scripts/check_performance.sh` reads this file after the perf suite runs and compares each metric's measured mean against the `budget` field. A mean that exceeds `failThreshold` breaks the build. Units are documented per-metric; do not change them without updating the parser.

metrics.description: Cold-launch wall-clock time. Measured with XCTApplicationLaunchMetric, which tears down the app and re-launches on each iteration.

Mean frame rate while scrolling through 50 seeded workout rows. Sampled by XCTOSSignpostMetric.scrollingAndDecelerationMetric. `check_performance.sh` derives fps from the signpost hitch ratio + elapsed time.
Hitches per second while scrolling. XCTOSSignpostMetric computes a hitch-time ratio; we convert to hitches/sec using a 16.67ms per-hitch approximation inside check_performance.sh.
Mean physical memory footprint over a synthetic workout iteration.
P50 wall-clock time from the Ask Coach tap to the first coach bubble reaching non-empty content. Computed by XCTClockMetric.
P95 wall-clock time from the Ask Coach tap to the first coach bubble reaching non-empty content.
